clusters.description: Gaethje on Demetrious Johnson's MightyCast dissects the Topuria win: predictable footwork, emotional mistakes, overconfidence, and that he won't fight again in 2026

clusters.doubt: 1076 (Marca, a day later) picks a different quote from the same Jim Rome interview and frames it as UFC indecision.

clusters.description: Fans on X react to Dana White floating a Topuria vs Pimblett non-title headliner
